blocks.text: Comparative anatomists (jandaron ki banawat ka muqabla karne wale mahireen) fossils aur zinda jandaron dono ki banawat (structure) ka mutala karte hain aur aisi mushabihat dhoondte hain jo evolution ke rishte (evolutionary relationships) batayein. Is mutale se evolution ki do qismein saamne aati hain.

a- Divergent evolution (alag alag simton mein evolution): Jism ke woh hisse jo banawat mein milte julte hon lekin kaam (function) mein mukhtalif hon, homologous structures kehlate hain, aur is cheez ko homology kehte hain. Homologous structures divergent evolution dikhate hain, yaani in structures wale jandaron ka ek mushtarka buzurg (common ancestor) tha; woh mukhtalif qismon mein evolve hue aur apne structures ko mukhtalif kaamon ke liye istemal karne lage. Maslan vertebrates ke appendages (baazu, taangein, par) mein milti julti haddiyon ki ek hi tarteeb hai, halanke un ka kaam alag ho sakta hai: urna (parinde aur chamgadar), tairna (whales aur dolphins), daurna (ghore), darakht par charhna (arboreal lizard, darakht par rehne wali chhipkali) ya darakhton ki shakhon se jhoolna.

blocks.alt: Chhe vertebrates ke agle aaza (forelimbs), aik jaisi haddiyan aik jaise rang mein: humerus gehra maroon, radius halka narangi, ulna surmai, kalai ki haddiyan surkh, haath ki haddiyan safaid. Insani baazu, paanch ungliyan 1 se 5; ghore ki taang, sirf ungli 3; chamgadar ka par, paanch lambi ungliyan 1 se 5 jhilli ke saath; parinde ka par, ungliyan 1, 2, 3 aur par (feathers); chhipkali ki taang, panjon wali paanch ungliyan 1 se 5; whale ka flipper, lambi ungliyan 1 se 4 ke number ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.5: Vertebrates ke agle aaza mein homology (kitab ki Figure 24.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang dekhein: har jaanwar mein upar aik haddi (humerus, maroon), phir do haddiyan (radius narangi, ulna surmai), phir kalai (surkh) aur ungliyan (safaid). Kaam alag hai (pakarna, daurna, urna, tairna) lekin haddiyon ki tarteeb aik hai; yahi homology hai jo mushtarka buzurg ki nishani hai. Ungliyon ke number batate hain ke ghore mein sirf teesri ungli bachi aur parinde mein teen.

b- Convergent evolution (ek jaise kaam ki taraf evolution): Woh aaza (organs) jo kaam mein milte julte hon lekin banawat mein mukhtalif hon, analogous organs kehlate hain. Mukhtalif jandaron mein aise structures convergent evolution dikhate hain, yaani aisa evolution jis mein mukhtalif buzurgon se aaye hue mukhtalif jandar ek jaise habitat (rehne ki jagah) mein evolve hue. Maslan parinde ka par aur keere (insect) ka par dono urne ke liye adaptations hain, lekin homologous nahin hain. In ki mushabihat sirf yeh batati hai ke urne ke liye janwar ke paas ek chauri, chapti aur hawa mein phisalne wali satah (gliding surface) honi chahiye.

Vestigial organs (bekaar ho chuke aaza): Jandar aksar aise structures rakhte hain jin ka faida khatam ho chuka ho. Yeh structures aksar kam taraqqi yafta (poorly developed) hote hain aur vestigial structures kehlate hain. Maslan kuch saanpon, jaise boa constrictors aur pythons, mein pichhli taangon (pelvic) ki haddiyon ke nanhe nishan maujood hain jo un ke reptile buzurgon ke appendages se bache hain. Kabhi faida-mand rahe structures ke aise nishan tabdeeli, yaani evolution, ki wazeh nishani hain.

blocks.title: Vestigial structures in humans
blocks.text:
Insani jism mein taqreeban 90 vestigial structures hain, maslan:
• Vermiform appendix, cecum (aant ka ek hissa) ka bacha hua nishan hai.
• Coccyx ya tailbone (dum ki haddi), dum (tail) ka baqi hissa hai.
• Wisdom teeth (aql daarh) vestigial teesri daarhein (third molars) hain jo insani buzurg paudon ko peesne mein istemal karte the.
• Kaan ke muscles bohat kam taraqqi yafta aur bekaar hain, lekin kuch log apne kaan mukhtalif simton mein hila sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Chamgadar ka par aur whale ka flipper homologous hain ya analogous?
blocks.explanation: Homologous: dono mein haddiyon ki ek hi tarteeb (humerus, radius, ulna, kalai aur ungliyan) hai, lekin kaam mukhtalif hai (urna aur tairna). Yeh divergent evolution ki misaal hai.

items: Homologous structures: banawat ek jaisi, kaam mukhtalif; mushtarka buzurg; divergent evolution (vertebrates ke forelimbs).
Analogous organs: kaam ek jaisa, banawat mukhtalif; mukhtalif buzurg; convergent evolution (parinde aur keere ke par).
Vestigial structures (python ki pelvic haddiyan; insaan mein appendix, coccyx, wisdom teeth, kaan ke muscles) evolution ki nishani hain.
